name: Facet
text: We should adopt a system-wide dark theme by default because it provides better visibility and reduces eye strain, making our interface more enjoyable to use. This decision is supported by the success of similar dark-themed interfaces, such as Manus Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard. By doing so, we're trading off the potential need to accommodate users who prefer light themes, but this trade-off is worth it for the overall improvement in user experience. This dark theme will also contribute to a consistent and lively visual identity for our Excava interface.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode by default blinds users in bright rooms—glare on screens kills focus. Instead, let users pick at first launch and remember their choice; settle this with a 2-week A/B test measuring task speed and reported strain in both modes.

name: Facet
text:
Adopt a system-wide dark theme by default with a persistent, non-modal light-switch toggle. This maximizes visibility and comfort in typical work conditions while giving users control without disrupting flow. The trade-off is occasional glare in bright rooms, but that’s rare for our users and outweighed by the gains in focus and enjoyment.

text: Pane: A persistent toggle still forces users to choose upfront—some will pick dark mode blindly, others will toggle repeatedly, slowing them down. The real risk is inconsistent experiences fragmenting our interface’s clarity. Settle it with a 3-week adaptive test: default to system preference, but let users override once with a one-time banner, then measure task speed and strain before locking the default.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default to **system-aware theme** (auto-switching between light/dark) with a persistent, non-modal toggle for manual override.

Result: A single, seamless theme system that adapts to user environment without forcing upfront choices. Owned by Facet.
